30 boots bases, 15 uniques, 21 issued pieces (art/items/<slug>.png); 6 notables and 21 fillers (art/nodes/<slug>.png); 6 route bands and the Plots banner (art/places/); the sealed crate (art/crates/sealed.png). Nothing on disk is overwritten.

Shows by name: the uniques, the issued pieces, the nodes. Wiring after art.done: the 30 boots ART_AS entries off; ROUTE_ART69 to the route_ names; the banner's head_art to "The Plots"; SEALED_ART69 to crates/sealed. ++ --parallel 3.
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_art71_manifest.py; check with python3 tools/art_lint.py tools/pixellab_art71_manifest.json.
